en: Sepia postcard showing two churches in a rural landscape. On the left is a large neo‑Gothic brick church with a tall spire; on the right is a smaller, older whitewashed stone church surrounded by trees and a low stone wall. A path crosses a grassy field in the foreground. The lower part of the postcard contains printed Swedish text identifying the scene, along with a black‑ink handwritten message. The year "1903" is printed on the right side of the image.
